superPowers.name: King of the Inhumans (Affiliation: Inhumans)
superPowers.body: Once during each of your Turns, 1 allied character within |!range| 5 of an Activating character may spend 1 |!power| at any time. If it does, the Activating character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Anti-Graviton Field
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.

superPowers.name: A King Serves His People
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 2 is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of Range and LOS.

superPowers.name: Focus Power
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack and defense rolls.

erratas.body: King of the Inhumans is now |!range| 5 instead of 3. The character gaining 1 |!power| can now only be the Activating character.
Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Healthy side.
Strength for "Energy Bolt" increased from 5 to 6.
Power cost for "Master Punch" decreased from 4 to 3.
Superpower "A King Serves His People" added on Healthy side, granting a bodyguard capacity.
"Focus Power" becomes Innate instead of Active. It gives 1 |!power| during the Power Phase instead of adding 2 dice the attack rolls of the next attack action made this turn.
